Draft a complete title + first paragraph as a new content file ready to schedule as the next publish.
proposals.new_text:
---
title: "You earn well. So why does your savings account say otherwise?"
pubDate: 2026-04-28
description: "The gap between a good income and a growing net worth isn't a maths problem. It's worth an honest look."
---

You've got a salary most people would consider a success. Maybe you did too, at first. But the number in your savings account — or the absence of one — keeps pulling at you.

This isn't about not earning enough. You know that. It's about something quieter: the part of you that earns steadily and spends just as steadily, and hasn't quite looked at why.

That's not a character flaw. But it is worth turning toward.
proposals.impact: Attract higher-intent ICP readers who self-identify as 'earns well, doesn't build'; improves quiz lead quality
